simple.meaning: לִבְנִי (Libnîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לִבְנִי (H3846) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 3:21, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לִבְנִי (H3846) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לִבְנִי (H3846) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לִבְנִי (Libnîy) / H3846 is traced through Numbers 3:21, Numbers 26:58 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively)

firstOccurrence.englishText: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

timeline.evidenceText: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
